Pure comparison accepts an exact target and None, and rejects changed context or namespace with a reconfirmation error.

events.summary: The confirmed deployment target is now bound to the subsequent provision and kagent install operations; mismatches are rejected before side effects.
Complete and verified by unit, lint, build, IPC, and trace-gate evidence.

Approval review (#18) found the Option<ConfirmedOperationTarget> guard could be silently disabled: every UI caller already passes expectedTarget, so a mistyped or dropped TS key would deserialize to None and skip the comparison entirely instead of failing.

Made expected_target a required (non-Option) parameter on provision_mlops_stack and install_kagent, and ensure_confirmed_target take &ConfirmedOperationTarget directly, so a missing key now fails Tauri deserialization instead of bypassing the guard. Dropped the now-unreachable None-skips-check test and updated docs/02-requirements.md §4.1 and the TS ConfirmedOperationTarget doc comment to match.
Pure comparison test suite covers exact-match, context-mismatch, and namespace-mismatch with the now-required expected target; the None-skip case no longer compiles and its test was removed.
